name: RAAVANAA
intro: A game, a trip, a good meal. Simple days that many children never get. Together we make them happen, and we show you every smile you helped create.
about:
**Raavanaa exists for one thing: giving children a day of joy they will remember.**

## Why we do this

Some children grow up without ever going to a game, seeing a new place or sitting down to a really good meal. Nobody close to them can afford it, and childhood does not wait.

At the same time, all over the world there are people who would gladly give a child one of those days, if only they knew where it was needed and could trust that it would truly reach the child.

Raavanaa brings the two together.

## What a project is

Every project is one simple, happy day.

- **A game** – bowling, an arcade, a day of play.
- **A place** – a trip to somewhere they have never seen.
- **A good meal** – a delicious dish, shared together, once in a while.

Small things. But they are the days a child talks about for years.

## How it works

**Initiated.** A teacher, a children's home, an organization or one of our members tells us about children who are waiting for a day like this. We visit, listen and make sure the need is real.

**Activated.** The day is funded by friends, family and supporters of Raavanaa, and then planned: the date, the place, the food and the helpers.

**Impact.** The day happens. We come back with the story, the pictures and what was spent, so everyone who gave can see the smiles they created.

## Our promise

- Every need is checked in person before a project is shared here.
- Every penny goes to the project itself. Nothing is kept for running costs.
- Every project shows its budget and who made it possible.
- Everyone who gave sees what their kindness did, with a story and pictures after the day.
- The children's safety and dignity always come first. Read our [privacy and child safety promise](/privacy).

## Be part of it

"Beyond the Lanes" is our promise to step out of our own lanes and into the lives of the children around us. You can [bring us a project](/contact?topic=suggest), [volunteer on the day](/volunteer), or [partner with us](/contact?topic=partner).

privacy:
## Your details

When you send us a message, volunteer or sign up for news, we receive only what you type in: your name, your email, and your phone number if you choose to give it.

- We use your details only to reply to you or to send you our news.
- We never sell them or pass them on.
- They are stored securely by the company that hosts our website.
- You can ask us to delete your details at any time through the [Contact page](/contact).

## Children come first

Our projects are for children, so their safety and dignity come before any photo or story.

- We share photos and first names only with permission from a parent, a guardian or the home that cares for the child.
- We never post a child's full name, address or school.
- Every story is told with respect. If you see something on this site that should not be here, [tell us](/contact) and we will remove it.

## Comments

Comments on project pages are public. Please be kind, and do not post personal details about anyone.
